title: Sine Rule, Cosine Rule and Area of Triangle
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Which formula represents the Sine Rule?
questions.explanation: The Sine Rule states a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C.

questions.question: Which formula represents the Cosine Rule for finding side a?
questions.explanation: The Cosine Rule for side a is a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc cos A.

questions.question: Which formula represents the Area of a triangle using trigonometry?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 ab sin C = 1/2 bc sin A = 1/2 ac sin B.

What is the value of cos 120°?
questions.explanation: Cosine is negative in the 2nd quadrant. Cos 120° = -cos 60° = -1/2.

questions.question: What is the value of sin 150°?
questions.explanation: Sine is positive in the 2nd quadrant. Sin 150° = sin 30° = 1/2.

When using the Sine Rule to find an angle, what ambiguity might arise?
questions.explanation: Sin θ = Sin (180° - θ). There can be two possible solutions (the ambiguous case).

questions.question: In triangle ABC, a = 8, b = 10, A = 30°. How many possible triangles exist?
questions.explanation: Since a < b and a > b sin A (8 > 5), there are two possible solutions (Ambiguous Case).
